language.name: English
site.title: Backpack Space
site.description: Pack your backpack, fight other players' backpacks and fly from planet to planet. A space game for your phone.
home.lead: Buy items in the shop, fit them into your backpack and send it into battle against the backpacks of real players. Twelve rounds, four lives, one run.
home.how.title: How a run goes
home.how.1.title: Shop
home.how.1.text: Every round brings gold and new items. Reroll, pin what you want, sell what you no longer need.
home.how.2.title: Pack
home.how.2.text: Bags and items take up room. Where an item lies decides what it boosts. Matching items side by side merge after the fight.
home.how.3.title: Fight
home.how.3.text: Your backpack fights on its own against a backpack another player built. The star ages phase by phase; at the supernova every fight ends.
home.heroes.title: Four heroes, four ways to play
home.free.title: Fair to play
home.free.text: No item can be bought for money. Every run starts equal; heroes, levels and looks are earned by playing. A season pass and Credits are optional.

support.delete.title: Delete your account
support.delete.text: You can delete your account in the game: settings, account, delete account. If you can no longer open the game, send a deletion request from the address of your store account to the support address above. We delete your account and confirm it. The website itself does not delete accounts.
